heard: The moon's surface dust smells like burnt gunpowder. Solar radiation gives that abrasive dust an electrostatic charge. Instead of resting quietly, the particles actually levitate above the ground. A nearly vacuum exosphere leaves the regolith completely exposed to space. Down there, surface gravity is only one-sixth of Earth's. NASA's Sophia Airborne Observatory detected water across that sunlit surface in October 2020. Across six Apollo missions, Exactly 12 humans walked on that ground. The only world humans ever visited carries that unmistakable scent.
